# MITE

> MITE is an industrial IIoT platform that connects assets, models business logic as declarative no-code rules, and turns operational data into decisions. Deploy on-premise, in the cloud, or hybrid. Founded 2019.

## About
- Founded 2019. Engineering team across Portugal, Poland and Belarus.
- Contact: info@mite.club, +351 961 034 229
- Slogan: the most flexible Industrial IIoT platform ever.
- Serves: manufacturing, pharma cold chain, logistics and fleets, distributed infrastructure, regulated industries.

## Capabilities
- Connectivity: MQTT, LoRaWAN, Modbus, OPC UA, REST and webhooks; open APIs.
- Logic: declarative no-code business logic — operations teams change thresholds, routing, approvals, escalation and KPIs without code.
- Integration: ERP, MES, SCADA, data lakes and custom systems; no forced stack or lock-in.
- Deployment: on-premise, cloud or hybrid — data can stay entirely inside your own perimeter.
- Compliance: GDPR-ready, role-based access control, immutable audit trails, configurable data retention, export logging.

## Pricing
- Start-ups: EUR 0 / month — up to 10 devices, full platform access, best-effort support.
- Start: EUR 99 / month — 10-100 devices, full platform access, 8x5 support.
- Scale: from EUR 99 / month — 100-1000 devices, full platform access, 24x7 support.
- Enterprise / OEM: custom pricing — unlimited devices, custom SLA, OEM / white-label options.
